title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager – Tendering & Commercial Documentation
description:
We are seeking an experienced, high-precision **Manager – Tendering & Commercial Documentation** to lead our complete bidding strategy, tender submissions, and central office documentation. In this key role, you will be the primary owner of end-to-end bid management—from tender identification and GeM portal execution to contract award—while driving high efficiency in central office record-keeping and corporate administrative operations. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in government (e.g., GeM, CPP Portal) and private sector procurement, technical tender compliance, and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Tender, Bidding & Commercial Strategy (Core Focus)**

* **Tender Sourcing & Monitoring:** Proactively identify, track, and evaluate potential government (e.g., GeM, eProcure, CPP Portal) and private sector tenders, RFPs, and RFQs across all relevant portals.
* **End-to-End Bid Management:** Lead the preparation, formatting, technical verification, and submission of complete technical and commercial bid packages, ensuring zero error and strict adherence to tender requirements.
* **Costing & Inter-Departmental Coordination:** Collaborate closely with Sales, Technical, R&D, and Finance teams to gather technical inputs, establish accurate pricing, and secure necessary commercial approvals.
* **Financial Instruments & Compliance:** Coordinate the timely issuance, tracking, and compliance of Earnest Money Deposits (EMD), Bank Guarantees (BG), Demand Drafts, and tender fees with the accounts team.
* **Post-Bid Lifecycle & Clarifications:** Oversee post-tender follow-ups, lead client communications, manage technical clarifications and negotiations, and coordinate contract execution post-award.

**2. Central Office Management & Record Keeping**

* **Document Control & Database Management:** Design and maintain organized digital and physical databases of all submitted tenders, vendor contracts, client agreements, statutory filings, and past results.
* **Office Administration:** Direct daily office operations, manage executive correspondence, oversee administrative services, and maintain seamless internal workflows.
* **Vendor & Supply Support:** Liaise with vendors for office equipment, utility maintenance, and corporate services to maintain a smooth administrative environment.
* **Management Support & Reporting:** Support senior leadership with periodic tender performance reports, status updates, and official corporate documentation.

**3. Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on experience in tender management, commercial documentation, and office administration (strong experience with GeM and e-procurement portals required).
* **Technical & Software Proficiency:**
* **Advanced MS Office:** High proficiency in **MS Excel** (formulas, cost modeling, data analysis), **MS Word** (formatting complex tenders and proposals), and **MS PowerPoint**.
* Deep knowledge of GeM portal, CPP Portal, eProcure, and private vendor bidding platforms.

**Core Competencies:**

* Exceptional organizational, auditing, and document management capabilities with sharp attention to detail.
* Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Proven ability to thrive under tight deadlines and manage multiple tender submissions simultaneously.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Content writer
description:
**Own Content & SEO Growth Initiatives**

* Support and execute content marketing strategies designed to improve organic visibility, engagement, and ecommerce growth.
* Create, optimise, and manage high-quality SEO-driven content across category pages, product pages, blogs, buying guides, and landing pages.
* Help scale organic growth across UK and Irish ecommerce markets.

**SEO & Content Optimisation**

* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Optimise content using SEO best practices including metadata, internal linking, search intent alignment, and on-page optimisation.
* Collaborate with SEO teams on technical SEO recommendations and content improvements.

**Content Creation & Editorial Excellence**

* Write, edit, and proofread engaging content aligned with brand tone and British English standards.
* Ensure all content is accurate, customer-focused, grammatically flawless, and optimised for search performance.
* Help maintain editorial quality and consistency across all digital channels.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with designers, ecommerce teams, and developers to improve user experience and content presentation.
* Collaborate with CRM, social media, and marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging and branding across channels.

**Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Monitor and analyse content and SEO performance using tools such as:
* Google Analytics
* Google Search Console
* SEO platforms and keyword tools
* Track rankings, traffic, engagement, and conversion performance to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Stay updated on SEO trends, search algorithm updates, and content marketing best practices.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in Content Marketing, SEO Content, or Digital Content roles within ecommerce or B2C environments.
* Strong understanding of SEO best practices, keyword strategy, metadata optimisation, and content structure.
* Proven experience writing high-quality long-form and commercial ecommerce content.
* Excellent command of written English with strong British English grammar and spelling skills.
* Experience using SEO tools and analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with CMS platforms for content publishing and optimisation.
* Strong editing, proofreading, and content quality management skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret SEO and content performance data.
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on UK or international ecommerce brands.
* Experience collaborating with SEO, ecommerce, or digital marketing teams.
* Familiarity with technical SEO concepts and search performance optimisation.

Experience in lifestyle, health, beauty, fashion, or ecommerce industries is a plus

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
Technical Content / Documentation WriterJob Overview

We are looking for a skilled **Technical Content / Documentation Writer** to create clear, accurate, and user\-friendly technical content and documentation. The ideal candidate should be comfortable understanding complex technical concepts and converting them into easy\-to\-understand documentation for developers, customers, and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and maintain **technical documentation, API documentation, user guides, and product documentation**.
* Write clear documentation for software products, features, APIs, integrations, and workflows.
* Convert complex technical concepts into simple and easy\-to\-understand content.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product managers, and subject\-matter experts to gather technical information.
* Create **API references, setup guides, integration guides, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and release notes**.
* Review and update existing documentation based on product and feature changes.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, consistent, well\-structured, and easy to navigate.
* Document technical processes, system workflows, configurations, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Research technical topics and validate information before publishing.
* Maintain documentation standards, templates, terminology, and style guidelines.
* Assist in creating technical blogs, knowledge\-base articles, and product\-related content.
* Track documentation gaps and proactively improve the overall knowledge base.

Required Skills

* Excellent **English writing, editing, and proofreading** skills.
* Strong ability to understand and explain technical concepts.
* Experience creating software or IT\-related documentation.
* Basic understanding of **APIs, REST, JSON, databases, web applications, and software development workflows**.
* Ability to work with developers and technical teams.
* Strong research and information\-organization skills.
* Attention to detail and consistency.
* Familiarity with **Markdown, Google Docs, Microsoft Office**, or similar documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple documentation tasks and deadlines.

Good to Have

* Experience writing **API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI or Postman**.
* Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub and documentation version control.
* Familiarity with documentation platforms such as **Confluence, GitBook, Notion, or Docusaurus**.
* Basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, or other programming concepts.
* Experience writing developer\-focused blogs and technical tutorials.
* Familiarity with SEO and technical content optimization.
* Experience working with SaaS, APIs, cloud platforms, or developer tools.

Experience

**1–4 years** of experience in technical writing, software documentation, content writing, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A detail\-oriented technical writer who can work closely with engineering teams and transform technical information into **accurate, structured, and easy\-to\-understand documentation** that helps both developers and end users.

Pay: ₹10,148\.13 \- ₹35,244\.43 per month

Work Location: In person
